examples.title: Shortcut field
examples.description: Capture a keyboard shortcut in an accessible field. The label renders as visible text by default.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ShortcutField } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ShortcutField label="Open command palette" value={['Meta', 'K']} />

examples.title: Compact field with hidden label
examples.description: Keep the accessible name from label while visually hiding it, for a compact toolbar-adjacent layout.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ShortcutField } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ShortcutField id="toolbar-shortcut" label="Toolbar shortcut" labelVisible={false} value={['Control', 'B']} />

examples.title: Validation and disabled state
examples.description: validate rejects a reserved combination through the shared FormField error region; a second field shows the disabled, inert state.
